node: AI data-center power chain: electrical equipment, cooling, grid interconnection and construction services
summary: Layer 1B expansion focused on scarce suppliers and execution bottlenecks around AI data-center electrical power, thermal management, and construction labor. The universe should not stop at mega-cap electrical leaders; the more Serenity-relevant discovery lane includes mid-cap vendors with direct evidence of data-center orders, backlog growth, or hyperscale/colocation customer exposure. Four candidates were retained: one reference leader for context and three underfollowed or less-obvious public-market mappings tied to switchgear, cooling, and electrical/data-center construction.
